blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Having a picky eater is hard. With cha…
blocks_element.text: Having a picky eater is hard. With change, some dogs dive right in, while others take their time warming up to something new. If your dog is hesitant, try thawing the food for 10–15 minutes to soften the texture, mixing it with warm water, or adding their favorite treat on top. Maev recommends following the transition guide closely, and you can always reach out to the Maev Experts for additional tips and advice. Give it time—new routines take patience, and we’re here to help every step of the way.

blocks_element.text: The Clean Label Project® Purity Award recognizes products that go above and beyond standard safety testing. In addition to screening for contaminants like heavy metals, pesticides, glyphosate, phthalates, and bisphenols. They present the award exclusively to products that perform in the top one-third of their category, making it one of the highest standards for product purity.

blocks_element.text: My Picky Eater Finally Loves Mealtime

My 12-year-old, 15-pound Maltipoo has always been a picky eater, but with Maev, she eagerly finishes every meal and actually looks forward to mealtime. As a senior dog, I wanted to give her better nutrition to support her gut and joint health, and so far, we're loving both the food and the results. Her stools are healthy and well-formed, which has been great to see. While she still experiences some arthritic tremors in her hind legs, her overall well-being seems improved. We're very happy with Maev and plan to keep it as part of her routine.
